text:
ryan: Quick sync — customer asks piling up on streaming behavior for chat. We need a concrete MVP decision (SSE vs WS), delta format shape, and what "finish reasons" we expose. Also call out launch gates (perf, SDK support, telemetry).

maya: +1. several customers asked for resume on flaky mobile networks and deterministic finish reasons for A/B evals.

alex: For infra: SSE is the lowest-risk to implement first (HTTP/1.1 friendly, works through most proxies). WS gives multiplexing and lower framing overhead but needs more infra changes.

sam: From perf side: WS improves push throughput for many concurrent small streams, but most of our customers' request patterns are single-stream chat flows. SSE fits 80% of cases.

liz: For evals we need an explicit taxonomy for finish reasons — opaque "stop" isn't enough. Customers want to distinguish model-initiated stop vs truncated-by-quota vs truncated-by-timeout vs client-cancel.

ryan: Proposal: MVP = SSE newline-delimited JSON chunks plus a small event vocabulary. SDKs implement reconnect with resume token as "phase 1" best-effort. WS and multiplexed binary protocol in phase 2.

alex: Example delta framing we propose (MVP):
```
data: {"delta":"hello","role":"assistant"}
data: {"delta":" world"}
data: {"event":"done","finish_reason":"stop","tokens_generated":12}

// newline-delimited JSON is easier for debugging and safe over proxies
```

tasha: DevEx: keep client surface minimal. Expose a single streaming endpoint: POST /v1/chat/stream with headers to opt into either sse or ws. Default to sse for browsers and mobile SDKs.

sam: Telemetry gating: must emit per-request metrics: first-byte latency, total tokens, truncated(boolean), finish_reason label, and resume_attempts. These need to land in Console before GA.

maya: Launch gates checklist (suggested):
- SDKs: JS + iOS + Android streaming clients with reconnect behavior documented
- Perf: 95th P50-first-byte <= 250ms for small prompts, and stable token throughput on dedicated runs
- Quality: finish_reason labels must be stable for 98% of test prompts (eval harness)
- Observability: finish_reason++ and resume_attempts in Console logs + sampling of full deltas
- Security/Quota: stream length limits enforced server-side (configurable per-customer)

liz: Also need structured-output / function-call signals in-stream. Suggest special event objects: {"event":"tool_call.start","name":"weather","args":"..."} and {"event":"tool_call.end","result":"..."}. Keep these as separate JSON events, not embedded in free-text deltas.

ryan: Decision sketch:
- MVP transport: SSE only, opt-in WS via header for early customers (tech-preview)
- Delta format: newline-delimited JSON events; two top-level keys: "delta" (string) and "event" (string) for control events
- Finish reasons: canonical set = ["stop","cancel","timeout","quota_limit","error","resume_possible"]
- Resume: support resume tokens in MVP but mark as best-effort (no strong consistency guarantees)

alex: Implementation notes for infra: avoid per-token sync points; stream via existing chunked-encoding pipeline and add small router changes for finish events. WS preview will reuse same message envelope.

tasha: Docs action: add code samples showing reconnect + continue-from-offset pattern, and clear guidance on when resume is guaranteed vs best-effort.

sam: Risk: resume semantics could give confusing duplicate output if SDKs double-apply. We need client idempotency token guidance.

maya: Customer asks that finish_reason be machine-friendly (single token) and human-friendly (short description). We'll map reason->message in Console UI.

liz: One more: for function/tool calls, mark the tool args as separate event so downstream evaluators can score tool invocation correctness without parsing free text.

ryan: Next steps: Alex + Sam to prototype SSE handler and event envelope this week. Tasha + DevEx to draft SDK reconnect patterns + examples. Maya will prioritize a small customer beta gating plan. I'll schedule a short canary review on Thu.

engbot: deploy: canary pipeline created for streaming-sse-mvp, namespace: streaming-canary, will report metrics to #eng-sre.

ryan: Thanks — if no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll lock the MVP scope and update the roadmap doc. :thumbsup:
